subject.title: fix(signal): preserve native quote replies from agent sends

question: Should `prepareSendPayload` permanently expose explicit-versus-implicit reply provenance to channel plugins as the bridge into provider-owned durable payload translation?
rationale: Signal needs caller intent to preserve explicit native replies without persisting inherited intent, but adding the field changes a shared plugin-facing contract and its long-term ownership cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Approve a canonical typed bridge
options.body: Keep the optional preparation field, derive its type from the canonical reply-provenance definition, and validate that sibling channel adapters remain unchanged.

options.title: Keep provenance payload-owned
options.body: Remove the new preparation field and expose the same intent through an existing canonical ReplyPayload metadata path consumed by Signal.

recommendation.title: Approve a canonical typed bridge
recommendation.body: Keep the optional preparation field, derive its type from the canonical reply-provenance definition, and validate that sibling channel adapters remain unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced the current-main reply planning and payload helpers that this contract extension composes with.
